gaps: No official page found that settles whether two-wheelers may use the Yamuna Expressway; two pages on one toll guide contradict each other.
No government order found for the two-wheeler ban on the Hyderabad Outer Ring Road; the sources are an encyclopedia and a newspaper.
The Jammu and Kashmir traffic police website could not be reached, so the advisory is cited from a news site that reprints it.
No source opened says whether Delhi's age limit for vehicles is applied to motorcycles, or to motorcycles registered in other states.
No source found for the best months. The number of days rests on one rider's account of a fast run.
No source found for heat in central India or monsoon flooding on the route.
No rule found for Gwalior, Nagpur, Madurai or Kanyakumari.
One video only, and its filming date and motorcycle are not known.
